text: 中信银行公告，2026年半年度分红派息方案为每股派发现金红利0.203元(含税)，共计派发现金红利约112.96亿元，其中，派发A股现金红利人民币82.75亿元(含税)。A股股权登记日为2026年11月19日，除权除息日及现金红利发放日为2026年11月20日。
text_en: China CITIC Bank announced that its 2026 interim dividend plan is a cash dividend of RMB 0.203 per share (tax included), totaling approximately RMB 11.296 billion in cash dividends, of which A-share cash dividends will be RMB 8.275 billion (tax included). The A-share record date is November 19, 2026, and the ex-rights/ex-dividend date and cash dividend payment date is November 20, 2026.
